sloka: तमाश्रमं महातेजाः पिता ते सुमहायशाः ।पुरोहितं महात्मानं दिदृक्षुरगमस्त्वयम् ।। ७.५१.३ ॥
transliteration: tamāśramaṁ mahātejāḥ pitā te sumahāyaśāḥ ।purohitaṁ mahātmānaṁ didṛkṣuragamastvayam ।। 7.51.3 ॥

translations.english: Your highly effulgent and very famous father went to that hermitage, desirous of seeing the great-souled priest.
